stages.purpose: Collect the planning request, source paths, conversation summary, requested depth, and title before deterministic artifact creation.
Choose minimal, standard, or deep planning depth and record the rationale. Ambiguous depth decisions are planner-owned judgment, not deterministic approval.
Build stable trace ids for requirements, decisions, implementation slices, acceptance requirements, and evidence expectations.
Classify meaningful behavior decisions as deterministic, generative, or hybrid and require explicit safety justification for deterministic handling of generative decisions.
Review command, architecture, and systemdesign consistency before implementation handoff.
Review whether planned checks and evidence prove the intended behavior without fixture-specific overfitting.
Review semantic judgment and multi-agent decomposition choices so ambiguous decisions use explicit generative stages with bounded context.
Validate review artifacts, trace references, scoped acceptance ids, and decision-surface policy before implementation handoff.
Emit machine-readable and human-readable `/ai-change` handoff artifacts with acceptance-source and acceptance-scope-file references.
Show planning run status without reopening unrelated planning or implementation context.

scripts.purpose: Create and validate `/ai-plan` run artifacts, enforce deterministic trace checks, and emit `/ai-change` handoff files. Template-derived projects may expose this same helper behind a local MCP adapter/server pair, but the helper remains deterministic and does not hide generative review work.

functions.purpose: Create a planning run and write the required artifact set for the selected planning depth.
Validate required files, unique trace ids, cross references, deep review artifacts, and decision-surface policy.
Print the machine-readable or human-readable `/ai-change` handoff for a run.
Show one planning run or the most recent active planning run.

local_mcp_backend_policy: When a template-derived project turns `/ai-plan` into backend-backed command orchestration, use a command-side MCP client and local stdio MCP server that call the same deterministic helper functions. Architecture, harness, and LLM-delegation judgment remain explicit generative stages rather than nested Codex child-session transport.

prompt_contracts.purpose: Classify planning depth with rationale and avoid deterministic substitutes for semantic ambiguity.
Translate planning intent into stable requirement, decision, slice, acceptance, and evidence ids.
Classify behavior decisions as deterministic, generative, or hybrid.
Review command and architecture consistency before implementation.
Review validation adequacy and overfitting risk.
Review whether semantic judgment uses explicit generative stages with bounded context.
